For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

subject: Help me train the next generation of leaders…
body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687485%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WOMfgJQe8wQKv72C4l9bpg&sysid=1)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you’d like to give online, here’s a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687486%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4tonR8ZRVTdSQQiFC6owqQ&sysid=1)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity’s show that I’ve partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I’m the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left’s cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America’s freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that’s when you know you’re saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America’s founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687487%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fTMjC198GxHQO3j36exdhw&sysid=1)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women’s identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687488%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2pYnwwxiMd92XRCtnnOnMw&sysid=1)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute
---
The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201, United States

---

American Update

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: A personal note about antisemitism
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
Sara Jacobs - Democrat, U.S. Congress [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89313/images/SDS/SJJ-emailheader1.png]
A note before you start reading: This email talks frankly about experiencing antisemitism and contains language that may be painful for some.
Like Jews all across America and the world, I’ve dealt with antisemitism my whole life. I recently spoke on the House Floor about antisemitism, and I’d like to share some thoughts with you, too.
Whether it's jokes about my big nose or my frizzy hair growing up – or being called a kike while waiting to get a drink at a bar in college – I’ve always known how hard it can feel to be Jewish. But recently, it has gotten worse.
Four years ago in San Diego, we mourned a beloved community member who was killed in the Chabad of Poway.
On January 6th, 2021, as insurrectionists stormed the United States Capitol, my colleagues and I hid under our seats in the House Gallery, wearing gas masks and waiting for a chance to run to safety. As we escaped through the tunnels, we saw insurrectionists in t-shirts emblazoned with the slogans “six million was not enough” and “Camp Auschwitz.”
In San Diego, we regularly wake up to swastikas painted on college dorms or sidewalks.
And it seems like every other day now, I’m tagged in a post on X (formerly known as Twitter), naming me as a “globalist” or a “Jew in power.” This week, some of the comments included:
“The nose gave it away.”
“The infestation is so bad.”
“She’s a good Jew” – as if only some Jews are “good enough” to deserve safety.
Antisemitism is hateful and deadly, and it’s only gotten worse since October 7th.
In our schools, in our communities, in our workplaces, and on social media – Jewish people are inundated with antisemitic rhetoric and targeted hatred.
It’s important that we talk about it. That we’re honest about the pain we’re feeling. That we work together to build a more tolerant and loving world around us. And that we don’t let opportunistic politicians cynically use our pain to divide us or score cheap points.
President Biden has been a true leader on this in recent weeks, bringing together Jewish Members of Congress at the White House to discuss a whole-of-society approach to countering antisemitism. As an immediate next step, we need to fully fund and implement the U.S. National Strategy to Counter Antisemitism.
It will take work to ensure that Jewish people are safe and respected everywhere, but it’s work that I’m committed to – not just for a news cycle, but for life.
I hope you’re with me. Thanks for reading.
–Sara

name: Riley Gaines
subject: Help me train the next generation of leaders…
body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhhqvu0vq78v2v92gfm7qeldg4qo1518q0a87j0g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chg69or2c1h2bs)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zq28s5or0a73lqt015m8839d7p321pt4br0vnoc0_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chg69or2c1h2bs)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zp5nqquj6qbcv9v748g7eojuveomr2vora4ti5qo_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chg69or2c1h2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvhsetv1upll104ctk9gfadtiga6q4sofjiekjg0_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chg69or2c1h2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute
---
The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201, United States

---

# Last Nights Party
**Please read below for our Christmas Outreach**
Last night, the South Bay Republican Assembly gathered for an unforgettable Christmas Party, where the spirit of the season blended with the enthusiasm of like-minded individuals. Festive decorations, spirited conversations, and a shared commitment to values created a joyous atmosphere, allowing attendees to revel in the moment. The event not only showcased the unity and camaraderie within the South Bay Republican Assembly but also marked a memorable celebration that underscored the strength of community and the warmth of the holiday season.
The evening reached its pinnacle with the surprise presentation of two prestigious awards for Republican of the Year. I was honored to receive one of these awards from our own board in the SBCRA, and the other went to an exceptional woman in the South Bay, Janice Webb, the Chair of the 66th Assembly Central Committee. As the room filled with anticipation, the deserving winners were recognized for their outstanding dedication, leadership, and contributions to the principles upheld by the South Bay Republican Assembly. These awards not only celebrated individual accomplishments but also served as a testament to the collective strength and commitment of the assembly's members to making a positive impact in their community.
The Christmas Party was more than just a festive gathering; it was a moment to honor excellence and inspire continued dedication to the Republican values that bind the South Bay community together.
Nena Gates
# Outreach
'Tis that time once more! We're embarking on our Christmas outreach initiative and gearing up to spread joy to those in need. The support from this community has been nothing short of incredible over the past two years, significantly contributing to the success of our outreach efforts. Last year, with your help, we were able to bring smiles to the faces of over 150 needy families through thoughtful gift-giving. This year, my hope is to double that impact.
Here's what we're on the lookout for:
For Kids:
New Clothes, Shoes, and Toys
Toddlers (boys and girls, 2-5 years old)
6-12 years old (boys and girls)
13-18 years old (boys and girls)
For Newborns:
Diapers
New This Year - Young Adults:
Items for young men and women
Example: Shoes, Clothes, Makeup, Cologne, Perfume, Electronics
For Parents:
Gift cards for necessities
Food
Groceries
Gas
Shopping
Your generosity has the power to make a significant difference in the lives of those less fortunate. Let's join forces once again and make this Christmas season even more special for our community. Together, we can extend the spirit of giving and bring warmth to the hearts of many.
Thank you for your continued support and compassion.

## My Husband Derrick Gates is running for Central Committee
---
Dear friends and fellow Conservatives, I am thrilled to announce that I am running for an official seat on the 66th Assembly District Central Committee. As some of you may know, I have been serving as an alternate on the committee for some time now. Over the past two years, I have also been actively involved in multiple posts within the party. I am proud to have been elected to the California Republican Assembly state board of directors as the Senate director for the 24th District, chaired the Faith Outreach committee for the CRA, and served as a delegate for the California State Party. These experiences have given me a deep understanding of the values and principles that are important to our party and have prepared me to effectively represent our district on the central committee. As a member of the central committee, I will work tirelessly to ensure that conservative values remain at the forefront of our party's agenda. I believe that my position on the LAGOP, which is the largest Republican party office in the nation, will allow me to have a greater impact on decisions that affect our party and our community. I have already been able to influence many decisions as an alternate, and I am confident that I can make an even greater impact as an elected member. While some have urged me to run for the congressional seat of the 36th district, I believe that my calling is to bring balance to the party for the next few years. This will not only benefit the party but also other candidates and myself in the long run. Federal races can be expensive to operate, and I have learned from my previous run for Congress that it takes time to build relationships and secure the support needed to win. My goal is to help fix the foundation of the party while building relationships with those who can help me in the future. I am asking for your prayers and support as I take this important step on my journey. Please look for me on the primary ballot on March 5, 2024. Early voting begins on February 24, 2024. Your vote for me, Derrick R. Gates, for the 66th Assembly Central Committee, will help ensure that our conservative values continue to be represented in our district and beyond. Thank you for your support and dedication to our party. Sincerely,
Derrick R. Gates

Friend, Just a year ago, it was unfathomable to me that I would be writing this email. It's a bit long, but I would ask you to read it in its entirety. I spent a lot of time writing it and did my best to make every word count. I write it with great sadness and astonishment, sadness for our country which I hold so dear, and astonishment at Joe Biden's desecration of the Oath of Office he took with his hand on the Bible in front of the world. **It has come to light that the Federal Bureau of Investigation has had 40 informants inside the Biden family over the past 15 years.** For 15 years, Credible Informants have been providing criminal information against the Biden's to FBI Field Offices across the country, and for 15 years, everytime the information has been brought to FBI HQ, the leadership of the FBI shuts it down. Derek –
A groundbreaking report by _ProPublica_ just revealed:
**Far-right Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas suggested to a Republican member of Congress that he might resign if Congress didn’t increase Supreme Court justices’ salaries.**
After that conversation in 2000, Republican megadonors lavished Clarence Thomas with **_“a stream of gifts from friends and acquaintances that appears to be unparalleled in the modern history of the Supreme Court,”_** from luxury vacations to tuition payments.

name: Katie Porter
subject: not good enough
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=35093%2E3422442%2EBJDX2W)
Derek, the election of Trump was the reason I first ran for office in 2018. Like so many Americans, I was angry, and didn’t want to just sit on the sidelines.
In 2018, I talked a lot about Donald Trump and his abhorrent policies, and we flipped a red seat blue.
**But I haven’t won two competitive re-election campaigns with that same strategy.** Trump is a dangerous threat to our democracy—that can’t be overstated, and we must do everything we can to both hold him accountable and ensure he never again steps foot in the White House. But our country’s problems didn’t start or end with him. Widening inequality, a broken healthcare system, and a climate crisis are symptoms of a system that puts ultra-profitable corporations ahead of real people.
**Getting to “better than the way things were'' isn't good enough.** Because it’s not “good enough” that huge corporations are making record profits while more and more families can’t afford necessities.
It’s not “good enough” that my kids had to ask me if they were safe at school after a shooting in a nearby church.
It’s not “good enough” that most Californians can’t afford to buy a home.
The elected leaders we send to Washington must be accountable to the people they represent. **And step one is getting big money out of politics, which is why I’ve never taken a dime of corporate PAC money.**
**I’ll be frank, I need your help to win this race.** My fundraising has fallen behind and there are less than three months until our primary. With our end of quarter deadline coming up on 12/31, anything you can give today will be especially meaningful.
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231220?refcode=EMAO23_1_REL_20231220_V1_F&refcode2=35093_3422442_BJDX2W&akid=35093%2E3422442%2EBJDX2W)
Thanks so much,
Katie

name: Rashida Tlaib
subject: How many Palestinians killed will be enough for my colleagues to say the words, ‘Ceasefire now’?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Right now, we are seeing two very different visions for the future of
America and the world.

Last week, Congress approved giving $886 billion of our tax dollars to
fund bombs, weapons, and war crimes. I voted against this massively
wasteful budget for war and destruction, which was the largest military
budget in the history of our country. This budget is impossible to justify
when our neighbors are struggling to put food on the table, fighting to
keep a roof over their heads, and rationing their medication.

My constituents sent me to Congress to invest in life and in everyday
working people. Last week, I was proud to stand alongside United Auto
Workers (UAW) President Shawn Fain and other union leaders calling for a
ceasefire now.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231220-rt.miI5wr&refcode=em20231220-32425&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=32425%2E1203867%2Erub1c6 ]Michigan Advance: Tlaib joins with UAW's Fain and others to call for
Gaza ceasefire

At the ceasefire rally, UAW President Shawn Fain said:

“The world has seen enough slaughter and devastation. Peace is the only
path forward... As union members, we know we must fight for all workers and
suffering people around the world. We must fight for humanity.”

My Yaba (dad) was a UAW member and I wish he was alive today to see his
union stand up and courageously say: Ceasefire now!

But even as our movement demanding a ceasefire grows, Congress continues
to fund more bombs and more senseless killing.

Why aren’t over 18,000 Palestinians killed enough for my colleagues to say
the words, ‘Ceasefire now’? Why aren’t over 7,000 children killed enough
for my colleagues to call for a lasting ceasefire for an end to this war?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231220-rt.miI5wr&refcode=em20231220-32425&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=32425%2E1203867%2Erub1c6 ]Donate to Justice Democrats and my campaign today to power our
ceasefire movement, as we raise our collective voice saying: “We choose
life over death.”

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231220-rt.miI5wr&refcode=em20231220-32425&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=32425%2E1203867%2Erub1c6 ]Contribute $3

Thanks to you, our movement is growing.

Together, we will keep demanding not only a ceasefire, but also an end to
the blockade on Gaza, an end to the dehumanizing system of apartheid, and
the return of all hostages and those arbitrarily detained. We will keep
pushing back against oppression here and abroad, and advocating for human
rights and freedom for all people around the world.

In solidarity,

Rashida

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1022&akid=32425%2E1203867%2Erub1c6 ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=32425%2E1203867%2Erub1c6 ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20231220-32425-footer&t=1024&refcode2=32425_1203867_rub1c6&akid=32425%2E1203867%2Erub1c6

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. body:
You can’t use taxpayer money to advertise for Big Drug

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75513190/444944025/1272516037?refcode=em_XX_XXXX.XX.XX_XX_XX_header_desk_of_andrei&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTlkNzA4OTAtNjg5Zi1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=4d_QqpIjhyCRD16OZ4vgo8QcO-JNbMwup15h3ExeQyk=) Peter, I wanted you to know that I have sent a letter to the Office of Congressional Ethics calling on them to launch a new investigation into David Schweikert.

Here’s why: Earlier this month, just weeks after taking a large contribution from Big Drug company Novo Nordisk, **Schweikert used a taxpayer-funded constituent email to advertise Novo Nordisk’s** “buy now, pay later” offer. | [FIGHT BACK →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75513191/444944027/141055548?refcode=em_fr_2023.12.20_b1_ac_all&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTlkNzA4OTAtNjg5Zi1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=4d_QqpIjhyCRD16OZ4vgo8QcO-JNbMwup15h3ExeQyk=)

It had nothing to do with his duties or any legislation – it was simply using government resources to put up a digital billboard for his drug company campaign contributor.

This contribution was no small potatoes – it was the second-largest one he received in the entire 3rd quarter of the year.

Doing the bidding of drug companies is not new for Schweikert. He has taken more than $260,000 from the prescription drug industry and has voted to protect their profits at the expense of higher costs. He voted against letting Medicare negotiate for lower prices, against capping insulin at $35 a month, and against cracking down on price gouging.

As a former Arizona Assistant Attorney General focusing on fraud and public corruption, I am ready to take on Schweikert’s shady ethics. I refuse to take a dollar from Big Drug companies or any other corporate PAC because Arizonans deserve a member of Congress who works for them, not corporate donors or special interests.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

body:
You have most definitely seen that the Colorado Supreme Court determined former President Donald J. Trump committed insurrection and therefore cannot be on their state's ballot. What you may not know is that back in October I testified at that trial. I want you to know why I did so. |
---
_Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District. _
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75514547/444948171/-1590518309?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS85MDcyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNzVkNGM4NC02YTlmLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=50c4EB_YQyumfOFp4_Ml7WYV5Com1Zc7zkR34RUbDQ8=&emci=18a484e2-679f-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=075d4c84-6a9f-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=7878003)
_This email is an issued correction for a previously sent email. We apologize for any confusion._ Dear friends, You have most definitely seen that the Colorado Supreme Court determined former President Donald J. Trump committed insurrection and therefore cannot be on their state's ballot. What you may not know is that back in October I testified at that trial. I want you to know why I did so. For too long Donald Trump has been a stranger to accountability. For decades Trump has acted as a legal terrorist. As a plaintiff he frivolously sues his enemies and he's often a defendant for failing to live up to his side of a deal. It's not surprising that many of you have expressed to me — on multiple occasions — that Trump will in fact never be held accountable for anything. When the plaintiffs in the Colorado case asked me to testify, one of my first thoughts was whether my participation would even matter. I was clearly jaded — like many of you — by years of watching Trump abuse our rule of law and re-offend without any consequences. Then it occurred to me how quickly that's changed in the last year. After all, Trump is now a defendant in four separate criminal matters to the tune of 91 felony charges. He's also facing scores of civil lawsuits, many that will soon yield decisions. body:
Florida is NOT a red state. It's a gerrymandered state.
| | |
---
Friend, this is the one thing that I need you to know about my race: **Florida is NOT a red state.****_It's a gerrymandered and voter-suppressed state._**
I've raised my family here. I've built my career here. I've served this state through work with nonprofits and in Congress. I've worked hard over the years to get to know every community that calls our state home. And over these past few months, I've spent just about every spare minute meeting even more voters as I travel up and down our beautiful state.
The majority of Florida voters don't support Rick Scott's far-right agenda. They believe in protecting reproductive rights. They don't want to see their taxes go up while the top 1% gets a tax cut. They want to keep their Medicare and Social Security benefits. They don't want leaders who sow division and lie to them.
But the Florida GOP has spent years gerrymandering our state to ensure that they hold on to power in Washington and Tallahassee and totally ignore what the majority of Floridians actually believe in. That reality helps to drive down turnout and leave voters disillusioned with politics. **And then, the extremists who've gerrymandered their way into office pass more and more voter suppression bills that make it harder for voters to cast their ballots every election year.**
**Florida is NOT a red state. But I need your help to prove it.[Will you make a donation now to help me build a winning grassroots campaign? subject: My mother’s battle with cancer
body:
| |

Affordable, accessible healthcare is a right that I will FIGHT FOR. | [View in browser](https://eqjdwl.clicks.mlsend.com/te/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjUwODYzOCxcImxcIjoxMDgxMTA3MjkyNTg3MzA5MjUsXCJyXCI6MTA4MTEwODE5ODE4OTk2OTk4fSIsInMiOiI3YTkxNjFjMzA1Y2Y0NjFmIn0)

---
|
---
Friend,
Last week my mom Trudy emailed you from our campaign email account.
She was given a heart wrenching diagnosis after she had gone to the doctor for some unusual symptoms: that’s when we found out she had breast cancer, which apparently had gone undetected for years.
Hers is not a story of medical malpractice—**it is about the flawed system of healthcare that we have in this country that puts industry profits over patient care and quality of life.**
****My father has been a small business owner and entrepreneur for most of my life. Before the Affordable Care Act, it was impossible for people like him to obtain health insurance. As a result, while they both juggled work and the demands of raising a family, years would go by where they did not have access to preventative healthcare. During one of those periods, my mom’s cancer went undetected.
I love my mom and am so proud of who she is and what she has done with her life. She is my best friend. She is a courageous woman who inspires me to be my best self, always. **While she continues to battle cancer, I will never stop fighting to improve healthcare—for her, for you and your family, for all of us.** [](https://eqjdwl.clicks.mlsend.com/te/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjUwODYzOCxcImxcIjoxMDgxMTA3MjkyODcwNDI0OTAsXCJyXCI6MTA4MTEwODE5ODE4OTk2OTk4fSIsInMiOiI4NDBmMGI3OWFlZGNmYmJmIn0)
| | [ ](https://eqjdwl.clicks.mlsend.com/te/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjUwODYzOCxcImxcIjoxMDgxMTA3MjkzMTIyMDgzMjUsXCJyXCI6MTA4MTEwODE5ODE4OTk2OTk4fSIsInMiOiI1MGYxMTEwZGM1NjUyMjdkIn0)
---
|
---
A sad fact about healthcare in America is that my mom’s story is not unique—**millions of us suffer, often needlessly, because corporate lobbyists, the pharmaceutical industry, and massive insurance companies have consistently thwarted major reforms in Congress.**
****The Affordable Care Act was a step in the right direction, and gave access to people like my mom and dad in ways that they never dreamed possible, but it is not enough.
There is so much more that we need to do to ensure that healthcare is recognized as a human right in this country. We can save lives and prevent unnecessary tragedy and hardship, like my mother and I are working through together.
But we cannot accept the status quo as a fact of life—**we have to come together and fight for a better system, and to create a more perfect union that helps EVERYONE live a happy, fulfilling life.**
****For my mom, and for every single one of us who knows what it is like to experience loss or to have to fight for your lives,**_I pledge to do everything I can to win this campaign and go to Washington to solve problems and get things done for US._** **
****__**[**Your support is truly the only way that we can be successful. Politicians like Jim Jordan will never work for us: they are only out for themselves. But Jordan is weak and vulnerable right now, and I am asking if you would support my work with a contribution of $25, $50 or more today:**](https://eqjdwl.clicks.mlsend.com/te/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjUwODYzOCxcImxcIjoxMDgxMTA3MjkzMjg5ODU1NDksXCJyXCI6MTA4MTEwODE5ODE4OTk2OTk4fSIsInMiOiJlY2ZkZTIzZTA4Yjk0NjhhIn0) [](https://eqjdwl.clicks.mlsend.com/te/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjUwODYzOCxcImxcIjoxMDgxMTA3MjkzMzk0NzEzMTIsXCJyXCI6MTA4MTEwODE5ODE4OTk2OTk4fSIsInMiOiIyZDhkMzU0ZWVmMzU3NzQ1In0)

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: The situation in Texas is dire
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
You may have heard the devastating news out of Texas—our state Supreme Court overturned a lower court and ruled that a Dallas woman, Kate Cox, couldn’t receive potentially life-saving abortion care as she faced a heartbreaking nonviable pregnancy. She was forced to leave the state to get the time-sensitive care she needed to protect her health and ability to have children in the future.
https://secure.ngpvan.com/cH3Q5sCTwUGSx2KU7gjAQw2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/cH3Q5sCTwUGSx2KU7gjAQw2]
I’m relieved Kate could get the abortion elsewhere when Texas failed her. But other women might not even have that option.
Four counties in Texas have passed ordinances that bar people from using local roads to drive someone out of state for an abortion. Like S.B. 8, they allow any citizen to sue a person they suspect of violating the ordinance. (How will they know why people are driving on the roads? Who knows. The confusion and the fear is the point.)
The situation in Texas is dire. Our state is ground zero in the fight for our freedoms and for the health, safety, dignity, and autonomy of women. That’s why we must pass my bill to protect the right to travel out of state for reproductive care.
While Texas is the leader, the frightening truth is that communities across the country are considering these types of ordinances prohibiting travel and turning citizens against one another. It’s shocking but not at all surprising. It’s why I introduced my bill in the first place.
The right to travel is one of our chief privileges as Americans and we must work together to protect it, as well as the health, dignity, privacy, and equality of women in Texas and across the country.
Let me know that you’re committed to this work. Add your name here. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/cH3Q5sCTwUGSx2KU7gjAQw2]
Together, we can do anything,
LizzieSignature [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]
P.S. Kate’s story is more evidence of why we need to win our race in the 7th District and take back the House next year. As always, we’ll need your help to do that. Your contributions support our efforts to mobilize Texas voters for our race and key races across Texas and the country. clean_body: Let's look back at the tireless work Cori's done for equal rights this year | | Peter, ** As we approach the end of 2023, it’s time for us to reflect on what we’ve done this year and what work lies ahead of us. So let’s go back to March, when Cori launched the first ever Congressional Equal Rights Amendment Caucus with Congresswoman Ayanna Pressley on the 100th anniversary of the Equal Rights Amendment (ERA) being first introduced in Congress. Cori took the lead here because it had been far too long for women, Black and brown folks, LGBTQ+ people, and other marginalized groups to wait for constitutional gender equality — and waiting longer wasn’t an option. We have to continue to support Cori’s work in advocating for gender equality and making sure that marginalized groups don’t get left behind. In addition to launching the first-ever congressional caucus aimed at recognizing the Equal Rights Amendment as part of our constitution, introduced a resolution in July to publish the Equal Rights Amendment in the federal register, cementing it as a formal part of the U.S. Constitution. Certifying the ERA as the 28th amendment would protect access to abortion care nationwide, defeat bans on gender-affirming healthcare, shore up marriage equality, eliminate the gender wage gap, help end the epidemic of violence against women and girls, and do so much more. Cori launched the ERA caucus and introduced this resolution to make sure constitutional gender equality is a national priority and that we continue to honor the long legacy of women and activists, especially Black women leaders, to build an inclusive multi-generational and multi-racial movement that guarantees the rights of all people in our country once and for all. Because equality is overdue. We need leaders like Cori who come from movements fighting for equality because that experience deeply informs her work and her commitment to the people. Cori knows that she’s building on the work that was started over 100 years ago and that it’s going to take much more work to get to a place where everyone feels safe and free regardless of their gender identity. She’s committed to it for the long run. We need Cori to keep building on the ERA work she’s done this year because we all deserve constitutional gender equality. I just wanted to circle back quickly on my email from the other day about the Gadwa-Boren situation.

Appreciate you all for sticking with me on this.

Here's to moving ahead together, championing our freedom of speech and fair legal processes.

Cheers,

Brian

name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Your Signature Is Needed: Polar bear families need you this holiday season, Friend
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2212775?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | _Just moments after making his debut into the world and taking his first little breaths, a newborn polar bear nestles up into his mamas’s embrace._ Like all polar bear cubs, this adorable soft white ball of fur is born _blind and toothless_ , weighing only about 1kg -- **roughly the size of a block of butter!** The tiny creature is completely helpless and will rely solely on his mother’s milk to survive the long winter months until he’s strong enough to make it on his own. Despite warming _**TWICE**_ as fast as the rest of the world, Arctic winters are undoubtedly harsh -- especially for vulnerable polar bears who are already grappling with the worst impacts of human-driven climate change, largely caused by the unethical practices of greedy Big Oil and fossil fuel corporations. **Meanwhile, the very same industry responsible for expediting the climate crisis continues to threaten the lives of innocent polar bear families.** Rampant drilling and fracking are causing irreparable damage to the already-delicate Arctic region: bringing in _noisy industrial-size equipment_ , dumping _harmful waste_ into the sensitive waters, contaminating _essential wildlife habitats_ , and releasing _toxic pollutants_ into the water and atmosphere that can pose _serious health concerns_ for residents in nearby coastal communities. Big Oil’s massive takeover of the Arctic is threatening people and our Earth while pushing precious wildlife like polar bears and walruses to the _**BRINK OF EXTINCTION.**_ _**How long will we let the fossil fuel industry’s insatiable drive for profit come at the cost of our planet and its living beings, Friend?**_ **[TAKE ACTION NOW: Demand federal protections against Arctic drilling before this precious region is DESTROYED by Big Oil’s corporate greed!>>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2212776?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2212777?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Not unlike humans, this time of year is one where polar bears spend a lot of time with family!** During summer and fall, these fascinating animals build maternity dens in preparation for the winter season when mama bears will give birth and nurse their newborn cubs. They start by digging small caves just large enough for mama to turn around, then they wait patiently for more snow to close the tunnel entrance and completely hide the den _where the family spends most of their winter snuggled up together._
While burrowed deep in the den, the mother polar bear doesn’t eat or drink. She remains inside devoted to caring for her precious cubs during the first two months of their lives. But excessive activity and noise caused by drilling and fracking can cause the polar bears to _**stop feeding, interfere with their movements, or even frighten mothers enough to abandon their dens _\-- and their cubs!_**_
And now, _MAJOR FLAWS_ have been identified in the accuracy of the technology used to detect and avoid polar bear denning sites. The failure to properly detect denning sites puts nursing mama bears and their weak cubs at **HIGH RISK** of being **_RUN OVER and KILLED_** by the massive drilling machines; or even being _**BURIED ALIVE**_ under mounds of snow, **_CRUSHING_** these helpless animals to death.
_**Denning season is already well underway, so this is URGENT, Friend.**_ Soon, new mama bears will welcome their fuzzy bundles of joy into the world -- and we must do everything we can to protect these iconic animals from _**DYING at the hands of Big Oil.**_ Polar bears are in serious danger of being _**WIPED OUT FOREVER**_ , so they’re desperately counting on activists like YOU to be their voice this holiday season: **[Please, will you take just a moment to add your name before this petition closes at 11:59 pm tonight? Sign now to STOP reckless Arctic drilling that’s harming nursing mamas and their precious newborn cubs!>>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2212778?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2212777?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

clean_body: Another step towards victory on March 5th. | | | | Hey Peter, This month, I filed my candidate statement with the Secretary of State — a huge step forward in our race to represent California's 30th. = As I started drafting my statement, I reflected on the road that led me here. Looking back at my time as LAUSD teacher, then — because of the impact of those very students — a civil rights advocate, attorney, nonprofit director, and school board member. As a teacher in Watts, I saw how poor leadership and structural inequity were holding back my students — and I knew I needed to fight back. I took on the school district and state on their behalf and won more funding for under-resourced schools. But there was still so much more to be done, so I ran for the school board, and fought to improve transparency, accountability, and budgets to help families and students. Now, I am running for Congress to bring a new generation of leadership that will take on the failed status quo and deliver for our communities.= Donate Now If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = ---|--- = | = = Right now, people nationwide are facing an affordability crisis — and our district is no exception. These struggles are political problems and they can be resolved with the right leadership. During the peak of the COVID-19 pandemic, I oversaw the distribution of over 140 million meals through the largest school-based food bank program in the country, and the expansion of childcare for working families. I've delivered real progress as a school board member — including championing the country's highest minimum wage for workers at schools, helping students and families find housing by building thousands of new homes for those who work at local schools, and adding vocational programs that open the door to middle class jobs. Now, I'm ready to bring that same energy to Congress. Too many families are struggling and our communities cannot afford to wait on the empty promises of politicians who have been in office for decades. I am ready to work with leaders of different viewpoints and across the aisle to expand affordable housing, lower prescription costs, establish universal preschool, and end big money in politics.= Our movement is part of a new, bold generation of leadership that voters want to see in Congress. Leadership that is ready to get to work and get things done. Thanks for standing with us, Nick = | | | Paid for by Nick Melvoin for Congress - FEC ID #C00831289 |

Before running for Congress, Kirsten spent five years working in the Arizona State Legislature — first in the House, then in the Senate.
The reputation she got while working there speaks for itself.
In 2019, she was named best Democratic Legislator for her “ law-school-professor-does-her-damn-homework style. [https://www.phoenixnewtimes.com/best-of/2019/megalopolitan-life/best-democratic-legislator-11363753] ”

In Congress, Kirsten will fight for reproductive rights, water security, public schools, and Social Security and Medicare — and she’ll do it with expertise and dedication.

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

**This is**** _exactly_****why I serve: because America is a sum of its parts, of the great places and people that have come together under an idea that we can be better and stronger**** _together_****.**

And it is why I am so excited about the upcoming 2024 campaign to take back the House and re-elect President Biden: because of what we have already accomplished, and what more we can continue to achieve together.
_Rick_

subject: Grateful

body:
Dear Peter,
I'm incredibly grateful for the success of my "Cup of Joe with Joe" tour and the tremendous support at my last event. Our coffee tour was just the warm up, and there are many more events to come all over the district next year.
Over my tour, I visited with voters from all over the district to discuss important issues, from the economy to the border crisis to local flooding problems. I'm thankful for everyone who came to a town hall, and I'm looking forward to the campaign trail next year.
When Marie Perez holds "town halls" it's only with pre-screened questions and pre-written answers. At my events, I took unfiltered questions and gave honest, heartfelt answers.
And it's easy to see why Marie hides from the voters in her district: she's voted against the Second Amendment, securing the border, and protecting women and girls' sports. She's fought energy independence at every step of the way and openly supports Biden's climate agenda.
Please donate to ensure I defeat my radical opponent at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/7MNyLqbAsCyOgS97632qlfaw/bpzhdEUoKWXEFf3AeOsG4g). You can also opt to make it a recurring contribution by clicking the "Make this Monthly" button.
Republicans are united behind my candidacy: I am endorsed by the Washington State GOP and six county parties. Republican voters understand that we need to be unified to defeat Marie this cycle.
Thank you to everyone who came out to my "Cup of Joe with Joe" tour. I'm grateful for all the support, discussions, and questions. I'm excited for the future of this campaign, and I hope everyone has a Merry Christmas!
Respectfully,
Joe Kent
PS - Please donate to help me get to Congress at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/7MNyLqbAsCyOgS97632qlfaw/bpzhdEUoKWXEFf3AeOsG4g).

| Peter,

As Washington’s Commissioner of Public Lands, _**I know what it's like to create groundbreaking change.**_

Since taking office, our Department of Natural Resources has actively invested in underserved areas, prioritizing those affected by poor air and water quality and increasing temperatures. **Through our efforts we are investing more than $1.6 million statewide investments to create healthier, more equitable communities.**

Trees are important, especially in cities. Trees in cities provide health, employment, and climate resiliency benefits that everyone should have. With increasing temperatures, they also cool neighborhoods, which reduces heat-related illness and utility costs. But a map of tree cover that we did of our cities reveals that low-income communities and communities of color have significantly fewer trees - especially in Tacoma. Reminiscent of the hundreds of millions of taxpayer dollars Obama
dispersed to failed green energy ventures, a struggling solar energy
company that received millions from the Biden administration is about
to fold. The northern California firm is called SunPower and it is
dedicated to energy storage and solar power. Last summer the
Department of Energy (DOE) gave it a $6.7 million grant and earlier
this year it received a $1.4 million contract from the National
Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA). This week SunPower shares
are down sharply following a Securities and Exchange Commission
(SEC) filing warning of “substantial doubt” about its ability to
continue operating.

Hi Peter,
I was looking back through our emails this year and was pleasantly surprised to see that our top-performing email of the year was Raquel’s announcement that she was officially running for Congress!
What a year it’s been, right? Raquel launched this campaign with the intention of building the biggest coalition possible and taking on the tough challenges ahead – whether that’s defeating MAGA Republicans or delivering solutions on healthcare, education, and climate change.
Just like the first day we launched this campaign, we are still powered by grassroots donors like you who are able to pitch in a few bucks here and there. It’s what keeps us going. DeAnna

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_122023_topperformer2023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_122023_topperformer2023]
Hi Peter,
I’m Raquel Terán and I’m officially running to represent Arizona’s 3rd district in Congress. In a moment, I’m going to ask you to become a Founding Donor of our campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_122023_topperformer2023] , but first, I want to tell you why I’m running.
In 2006, as I witnessed anti-immigrant sentiment and legislation gaining momentum in Arizona, I started organizing in our community with Mi Familia Vota. My deep belief in democracy, equality, fairness and family is as strong today as it was then.
That’s why I organized to oppose the notorious SB 1070 “show me your papers” racial-profiling law.
It’s why I ran for the Arizona House and why I was proud to serve in the Arizona State Senate, where I fought every day to make it easier to get ahead and provide for our families, by investing in our schools, making our neighborhoods safe, and bringing good jobs back to the district.
And it’s why I brought together a coalition of Democrats and Republicans, union members, educators, and youth activists to take on former Sheriff Joe Arpaio and Donald Trump.
Last year, with our democracy under assault, I brought our coalition together once again to reject GOP extremists like Kari Lake and elect a Democratic Governor, Secretary of State, and Attorney General for the first time in decades. That’s the power we can harness when we come together with a vision of Arizona that includes all of us.
Now, I’m running to take our fight to Congress and I can’t do it without you, Peter. That’s why I’m asking you to join our campaign today as a Founding Donor and help us build the foundation we’ll need to win. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_122023_topperformer2023]

I’ve spent my career organizing in our community for higher wages for our workers, affordable health care for our families, and better schools for our children. I’ve taken on far-right extremist bullies, and won. And now I’m running to represent our community in Congress.
If you’re ready to join us today, can I count on you to chip in whatever you can and become a Founding Donor to our campaign? Your investment now will allow us to build this campaign from the ground up, and win. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_122023_topperformer2023]

body:
| | Peter,

Climate change is a danger to our families and our way of life.

**A few months ago, the world experienced the hottest summer on record** — I remember receiving notifications, day after day, of excessive heat advisory warnings. As a boy, I’d spend the entire summer day outside playing. Now, streets seem deserted during weeks of 100-degree heat.

With climate change, **winters get warmer and winter storms become more extreme.**

We can expect worse than the one we experienced in 2021 when electric grid failures in the 2021 freeze led to 246 deaths. Texas isn’t used to such extreme winter weather, and bad policies have left us unprepared.

It’s true that Texas has always had _unique_ weather patterns, but climate change has made them more deadly because poor leadership has a disparate impact on our communities of color. **It’s time for change.**

**Fighting climate change can be a transformational economic opportunity that can raise wages and create stable careers for our communities.**

As a Representative in Congress, I will promote measures to continue expanding the Texan clean energy economy and work to protect Dallas residents most affected by climate change.

| | | | Dear Peter, Not sure if you knew about all of this... When Mike Dunleavy asked me to be his lieutenant governor, I said yes almost immediately because I knew I could help advance and grow Alaska. That's what motivates me to serve you every day. I've spent my career working to make life easier for Alaskans. From the state legislature to commissioner of the Dept. of Corrections to your lieutenant governor, every decision I made, I made it with you in mind. We've come a long way, but there's STILL lots left to do. I'll go to Washington with my sleeves rolled up and the same passion that has guided me every step along the way. # Party of the Constitution
---
**Does Unconstitutional Colorado Case Impact Republicans in Michigan?**

The Colorado Supreme Court has just ruled that Donald Trump should be denied a place on that state’s primary ballot. This will soon be appealed to the US Supreme Court. The Colorado Republican Party, threatened by the flawed Colorado Supreme Court decision, has stated that should the US Supreme Court find for the Democrats, it intends to“...withdraw from the Primary and convert to a pure caucus system...”
Democrats are attempting the same election interference tactic in Michigan.
The Michigan Republican Party filed an amicus brief represented by the American Center for Law and Justice in both the Michigan Court of Claims and the Michigan Court of Appeals., stating that the Party has the exclusive right to determine which candidates will appear on the Primary ballot. This brief was joined by 11 other Republican State Chairs (including Colorado) who have to stand as delegates to the Republican National Convention to select both a Presidential ticket and platform for the election season.
Michiganders and fellow Americans should know:
* The 14th Amendment Insurrection Clause was passed after the American Civil War to prevent Rebels who took up Arms against the US from holding office.

* An adjoining statute established how to “execute” the clause as required.

* This statute was repealed, rendering the clause ineffective or broken as it requires an Act of Congress to determine Insurrection.

The basis of our legal argument is simple. If nominated candidates win electors, they can present their views at the convention. This is a sound nomination process that helps shape the election narrative of the people. State courts cannot infringe on a party's rights to have a political convention and nominate leaders, voices, or factions.
On February 27, 2024, Michigan voters will select 16 electors (and 16 alternates) for the Republican Presidential nominating convention. Afterward, on March 2, 2024, Michigan delegates will select 39 electors (and 39 alternates) to attend a caucus with three from each congressional district. Therefore, Republicans in Michigan are somewhat protected from Democrats attempting to sabotage our primaries, but not fully.
It should be noted that MIGOP has been fighting for the rights of the Michigan Republican Voters and delegates and will protect the Republican primary process. We will continue to keep you updated.

name: Vicente Gonzalez
subject: A hole in your roof
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Vicente Gonzalez for Congress Committee
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20231220_em_fr_b1_VG_initial [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20231220_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
Friend,
It's getting colder in South Texas, a reminder that some families in our community face the bitter cold even within their homes.
As a lawyer for over 20 years, I've helped people in our community have a safer and better place to live , taking on cases that others might shy away from to fight big companies looking to take advantage of us.
I have always believed in standing up for those who need it the most, and my commitment to this principle has only grown stronger over the years.
One story close to my heart involves a family whose home, damaged by Hurricane Sandy, left them with a **wide hole in the roof** that they covered with plastic bags, leaving them exposed to the elements. Through hard work and litigation, we secured justice and provided them a new home.
Our neighbors and community members deserve a safe and warm place to call home, which is why I want to continue to fight for our district in Congress.
Our region, especially the colonias in South Texas, faces unique challenges that demand a strong voice in Congress and who understands their unique challenges and is committed to finding real solutions.
I am committed to being this advocate, but I need your help.
Friend, as December unfolds and the temperatures drop, we must work hard to make sure no one in Texas faces the winter without a secure roof over their head. Will you help me win this crucial seat by donating to my grassroots campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20231220_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
DONATE TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20231220_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
In unity,
Congressman Vicente Gonzalez
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20231220_em_fr_b1_VG_initial [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20231220_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.

Time sensitive!? ? ? ? ? Peter,

We are officially less than a year away from the critical 2024 elections and the end of year is weeks away! Time is starting to slip on supporting several must win races ? so we hope you will support three incredible champions today so that they can build momentum to WIN next year.

Colin Allred (TX), Debbie Mucarsel-Powell (FL), and Ruben Gallego (AZ) have proudly served their neighbors in the House of Representatives and are now running to defend and expand our pro-climate majority in the Senate and usher in new climate leadership.

Will you support their campaigns before the end of year by making a donation through GiveGreen today? https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/KybpT46aRDBe/bG1VL1g0UnVCbTlsQUpPQ0hHYWZoNlMyNEJubGd1aFVjUVJWYWhEWXByNERkNzNoRUlpUEZHQStrakRPS0tLWnZVYjN5UitPT3lwb0s3VXlkNVp2bUtNUC9TZ3dNalFnZzRJZkpQOGFqYjQ9S0/ DONATE https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/qjPNc8bVarH9/bG1VL1g0UnVCbTlsQUpPQ0hHYWZoNlMyNEJubGd1aFVjUVJWYWhEWXByNERkNzNoRUlpUEZHQStrakRPS0tLWnZVYjN5UitPT3lwb0s3VXlkNVp2bUtNUC9TZ3dNalFnZzRJZkpQOGFqYjQ9S0/
Colin Allred is running to represent Texans in the Senate. He has consistently opposed attacks on our environment and has been a strong proponent of the clean energy and environmental justice provisions passed in the Inflation Reduction Act. Through his work on the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, Colin Allred secured over $100 million to electrify public transportation systems around Dallas. In the Senate, he will work to solidify Texas as a leader in wind and solar energy job creation as well as continue to fight for clean air and water.

Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is running to represent Floridians in the Senate. While in the House, she served on the Water Resources & Environment Subcommittee of the Transportation & Infrastructure Committee and was called "a leading freshman voice on environmental issues, especially water policy," according to E&E News. South Florida is ground zero for climate change impacts, including sea level rise. If elected to the Senate, she will continue to fight for clean air and water, protect Florida's Everglades, and reduce carbon pollution by investing in clean energy.

Ruben Gallego is running to represent Arizonans in the Senate. He helped pass the biggest investment in climate action and environmental justice ever, the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA), and has championed the benefits this landmark legislation is providing for communities, including securing funding to improve air quality monitoring in Arizona. Ruben Gallego has stood up against industry exploitation of the Grand Canyon and other important natural places in Arizona, and has championed water conservation efforts and strengthening our democracy.

These three races are crucial opportunities to defend and expand our pro-climate Senate majority next year. Can you chip in through GiveGreen today to support these climate champions running for the U.S. Senate? https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/WabwQxgZN0hW/bG1VL1g0UnVCbTlsQUpPQ0hHYWZoNlMyNEJubGd1aFVjUVJWYWhEWXByNERkNzNoRUlpUEZHQStrakRPS0tLWnZVYjN5UitPT3lwb0s3VXlkNVp2bUtNUC9TZ3dNalFnZzRJZkpQOGFqYjQ9S0/

Thanks for all that you do, Peter,

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75523316/444975004/931971737?refcode=BLU_EM_JANE_2023-12-20_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFkMjEwNzk2LTgzOWYtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=jy54dmrhDLfp3dZjR28Rr9jtpv8r3Iwb1Yrx8F_j8dM=)
---
| Hi friend,

Although you and I have most likely never met, if you’re reading this, I know we have at least two things in common — a passion for combatting the climate crisis and a deep appreciation for Jane Fonda, for her energy, her resilience, and her conviction in the face of adversity.

They say never meet your heroes, but "they" must not have met Jane Fonda. I've gotten to know Jane not just as a cultural icon but as a friend and personal hero.

As we celebrate her 86th birthday, I'm reminded that it is essential to express gratitude to those who shape our world for the better. So, I offer you my way of appreciating Jane by turning an iconic moment in her vital history into art:
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75523317/444975005/420108225?refcode=BLU_EM_JANE_2023-12-20_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFkMjEwNzk2LTgzOWYtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=jy54dmrhDLfp3dZjR28Rr9jtpv8r3Iwb1Yrx8F_j8dM=)
This piece, rooted in the power of her 1970 mugshot, is a tribute to Jane's deep commitment to justice, unyielding spirit, and the defiant fist she raised—a symbol that still echoes in the hearts of activists.

Jane has taught us that the personal is political and that our voices can roar against injustice and inspire others to speak out. [_**I invite you to join me in celebrating Jane's journey at AppreciatingJane.com.**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75523318/444975006/420108225?refcode=BLU_EM_JANE_2023-12-20_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFkMjEwNzk2LTgzOWYtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=jy54dmrhDLfp3dZjR28Rr9jtpv8r3Iwb1Yrx8F_j8dM=)

There, you will find an opportunity to share your appreciation with Jane and, if you can, support the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, the mission to which she dedicates the rest of her life.

With any contribution, you'll receive an expression of this artwork, including some signed by Jane and me.

Let's continue to be loud, be heard, and be grateful.

With deep gratitude,
Shepard Fairey

It's often misleading, inaccurate, and just plain biased. **Now, as Israel faces a desperate fight for its future, I’ve increasingly found myself turning to the outstanding and unique coverage of The New York Sun**.

He’s joined his colleagues in pushing to codify abortion rights and undo Texas’s extreme abortion ban. And he’s pushed for better investments in our nation’s rural communities, farms, and food assistance programs. We need your help to make sure Greg can continue that work in another term in Congress.= Thank you, -Tara Tara Pohlmeyer Communications Director Greg Casar for Congress ****=** | ****** ---|---

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=984215c5924b4132aed412c365daf214&_e=ZMgnpz0tea0DRME4n-vlaajzc2-hgf79aahb_GSLUh0sZvXQtnVBksoFXrXzJCorwD_8dhcVh4KfP_wKkZ7NoDYTifmubnPC5NivbRgq7Ydl4Jtk2K4r-XA5GtxRABXCf-Je_AD0OdYMSo_LuE2-dpmW95bnmkQsZ08vg5iqInMusHmKb7NCNgwPFzwVWhwfPmpikK05R_zfDg3x2XOWRjbB3DvH7DPSa0NBGZottMJlWChic-wucWt2ZxGNqIv-5Dk2fzS7uMaoqZ5b29g7F6mzKLqFZrby9irk8sLaeqk0JiyKvrECHxJJOkyuEaHo_DnYaJ_SMVPWT6Zl118DX-8jhC62G7wS1p7rcnrDrjg%3D)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:
* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=984215c5924b4132aed412c365daf214&_e=ZMgnpz0tea0DRME4n-vlaajzc2-hgf79aahb_GSLUh0sZvXQtnVBksoFXrXzJCorwD_8dhcVh4KfP_wKkZ7NoDYTifmubnPC5NivbRgq7Ydl4Jtk2K4r-XA5GtxRABXCf-Je_AD0OdYMSo_LuE2-dpmW95bnmkQsZ08vg5iqInMusHmKb7NCNgwPFzwVWhwfPmpikK05R_zfDg3x2XOWRimZ3nhuVszRBKiVgSV1ssWSWL3KteJqYmPW2xtteajV8FWFUbvoa2JoitJte_Kz9fqeR_W2ckTzgStkP73HYAiu9C0bqdYiXoJ8lxwFr2pCyuoQJ1L948TZtgSb5zwR7Blant5s5tMXM6EDWhD_q_Q%3D)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

subject: Our most important month yet

body:
This is our most important financial deadline yet.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/130?refcode=em20231220&t=1&akid=734%2E62735%2E4IMMWd)
Peter, this is urgent.
We’re quickly approaching the end of December and with it comes a lot of exciting things like the holiday season and the new year.
For political campaigns like ours though, it’s one of the most stressful times of the year. A lot of folks are offline spending much deserved time with their loved ones.
**However, we’ve got our most important fundraising deadline of the year coming up. On December 31 at midnight, we need to meet our ambitious goal of raising $50,000.**
It’s essential that we reach this goal because our quarterly fundraising numbers will be shared publicly as part of the FEC’s fundraising rules.
Having strong fundraising numbers is critical. It will help show the world that our campaign is a force to be reckoned with.
It could help convince voters who are on the fence that we have a real shot at this and even prevent more opponents from running in our race.
**[No matter the size your donation today will help make a big difference in our progress. Can you rush a donation of any amount now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hh-em-20231220?amount=5&refcode=em20231220-734&refcode2=734_62735_4IMMWd&akid=734%2E62735%2E4IMMWd) **

We got some sobering news in Michigan, team: Yesterday, the nonpartisan political forecasters at the Cook Political Report downgraded from Lean Democrat to a pure TOSS UP for the 2024 election.
Why is this important? Well, it confirms something Michiganders know, which is that Michigan is NOT a solidly blue state. Despite the amazing success Democrats have had up and down the ticket the last few years, Michigan is a pendulum that constantly swings back and forth under the right conditions (just think back to 2016 when Donald Trump won Michigan by 10,704 votes.)
**This means that the second people sleep on Michigan based on previous successes, Democrats lose the state. We need to be doing everything we can right now to set us up for success on Election Day so we can protect the White House and defend the Senate.**

body:
Hi Derek, it’s been less than a year since I became Governor. And every day, my team’s had a GSD – get sh*t done – attitude.

**I want to take a moment to walk through the progress we’ve made together for Pennsylvania.[I’ll warn you: it’s a long list. So if you don’t have time to read it all right now, I hope you’ll still consider chipping in to help us keep fighting for Pennsylvania in 2024.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75525912/444980693/396869819?refcode=email_122023_accomplishments&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzMxZmFjOS04YTlmLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zen01LT3OZD7Blo2DHxc-h25_5pREo2omOrm1VmPsLM=)** | | [Donate →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75525913/444980694/396869819?refcode=email_122023_accomplishments&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzMxZmFjOS04YTlmLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zen01LT3OZD7Blo2DHxc-h25_5pREo2omOrm1VmPsLM=)
---
We’ve gotten a lot of stuff done this year. Here’s just some of it:

When a tanker truck crashed in Northeast Philadelphia under 1-95, we got that road reopened in just 12 days – and we set up a live stream for people to watch the work get done.

We delivered the largest increase in public education funding in the history of Pennsylvania, even with a divided legislature.

We delivered universal free breakfast for 1.7 million Pennsylvania schoolchildren.

We passed the largest targeted tax break for seniors in nearly two decades.

We secured more than a billion dollars in private sector investment. That's more funding for our farmers, and for the first time ever, state funding for minority, women and veteran-owned small businesses.

We sped up government, eliminated backlogs and slashed red tape.

We created a money-back guarantee system for the first time. So if you don't get your permit in time, we'll give you your money back.

We funded nearly 400 new Pennsylvania State Troopers.

On day one, I signed an executive order eliminating the college degree requirement for 92% of state government jobs, because we value skill and experience not arbitrary degree requirements.

We were the only state to secure two regional hydrogen hubs and all the jobs that come with them, making Pennsylvania the center of the clean energy universe for years to come.

And I brought Automatic Voter Registration to Pennsylvania, and in just the first two months, 58,000 people have registered to vote or updated their voter registration status.

When the nation's eyes were on Pennsylvania, we showed that we can do big things again. But there’s still more work to do, and I’m not going to slow down.

**[I’ll keep working my tail off to bring people together to get common sense things done for Pennsylvanians, and I hope I can count on your support in the big fights ahead.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75525914/444980695/396869819?refcode=email_122023_accomplishments&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzMxZmFjOS04YTlmLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zen01LT3OZD7Blo2DHxc-h25_5pREo2omOrm1VmPsLM=)**
