clean_body: Hi Derek, it’s been less than a year since I became Governor. And every day, my team’s had a GSD – get sht done – attitude. I want to take a moment to walk through the progress we’ve made together for Pennsylvania.= | | = We’ve gotten a lot of stuff done this year. Here’s just some of it: When a tanker truck crashed in Northeast Philadelphia under 1-95, we got that road reopened in just 12 days – and we set up a live stream for people to watch the work get done. We delivered the largest increase in public education funding in the history of Pennsylvania, even with a divided legislature. We delivered universal free breakfast for 1.7 million Pennsylvania schoolchildren. We passed the largest targeted tax break for seniors in nearly two decades. We secured more than a billion dollars in private sector investment. That's more funding for our farmers, and for the first time ever, state funding for minority, women and veteran-owned small businesses. We sped up government, eliminated backlogs and slashed red tape. We created a money-back guarantee system for the first time. So if you don't get your permit in time, we'll give you your money back. We funded nearly 400 new Pennsylvania State Troopers. On day one, I signed an executive order eliminating the college degree requirement for 92% of state government jobs, because we value skill and experience not arbitrary degree requirements. We were the only state to secure two regional hydrogen hubs and all the jobs that come with them, making Pennsylvania the center of the clean energy universe for years to come. And I brought Automatic Voter Registration to Pennsylvania, and in just the first two months, 58,000 people have registered to vote or updated their voter registration status. When the nation's eyes were on Pennsylvania, we showed that we can do big things again. Dear Peter,
Have you had it with the broken two party system in Washington? If so, you’re not alone.
Record numbers of Americans say we’re on the wrong track and want an independent choice for President. In fact, Independent candidate Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s net favorability leads the entire field of the two party presidential candidates by a wide margin.
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=favor_12_20_23_email_1_2_nd&n=2)
There is no mention of Republicans or Democrats in our Constitution. Think about that. Decade after decade, the two major political parties have slowly wrestled the people’s government away from us. It’s time to take our country back.
[DONATE TODAY >> ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=favor_12_20_23_email_1_2_nd&n=3)
The last Independent President we had, George Washington warned that through political parties, “unprincipled men will be enabled to subvert the power of the people and to usurp for themselves the reins of government.” Sound familiar?
**And where have the two parties in Washington led us recently?**
After the failed policies of the Trump and Biden administrations, the top 1% now owns more wealth than the entire 60% in the middle. The Trump Biden lockdown economy has saddled us with an unacceptable crisis. Working Americans can no longer afford life in America. Americans, on average, are borrowing $5000 a year on credit cards to meet their needs.
We are facing a disparity in income that is downright dystopian. Income inequality today is worse than it was in 1774 before our revolution.
_Fortunately, we can revolutionize America once again through the historic candidacy of Robert F. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
Every dog deserves a loving home.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75527428/444984273/1806212802?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjBmYTk2MTEtOGU5Zi1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kskOSJ-Zp6C0Xqi_zRdEiZu2y2gIkbt2qb7ojLh5MK4=) | Peter, As you know, I love dogs. Pam and I have fostered dozens of pups over the last few years. We love getting to know their personalities and taking them out to explore (or sniff) our neighborhood. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75527429/444984274/2015359279?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjBmYTk2MTEtOGU5Zi1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kskOSJ-Zp6C0Xqi_zRdEiZu2y2gIkbt2qb7ojLh5MK4=&emci=3eb9030b-8e9f-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=20fa9611-8e9f-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=6455652)** I believe every dog deserves to have a loving home. That’s why I was so sad when I heard a story recently that broke my heart - over 150 dogs were rescued from a horrific puppy mill. I genuinely don’t understand how someone could intentionally hurt these dogs. It comes down to greed - plain and simple. **Then I did some research and found that the Humane Society estimates there are over 10,000 of these puppy mills in the United States! It’s just terrible.** That’s why I’m a proud co-sponsor of the Puppy Protection Act. clean_body: Every dog deserves a loving home. | = | Peter, As you know, I love dogs. Pam and I have fostered dozens of pups over the last few years. We love getting to know their personalities and taking them out to explore (or sniff) our neighborhood. I believe every dog deserves to have a loving home. That’s why I was so sad when I heard a story recently that broke my heart - over 150 dogs were rescued from a horrific puppy mill. I genuinely don’t understand how someone could intentionally hurt these dogs. It comes down to greed - plain and simple. Then I did some research and found that the Humane Society estimates there are over 10,000 of these puppy mills in the United States! It’s just terrible. That’s why I’m a proud co-sponsor of the Puppy Protection Act. This legislation will raise the legal standards to ensure all dogs are treated with basic necessities such as food, water, and veterinary care. \- Josh *

subject: Friday Symposium: The Miracle of Christmas, 1776
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sare for Senate
body:
| | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231222_symposium&n=1)
---
Friend (Please see the note at the bottom for an important Thursday event.) There is probably no single day in history more decisive for the creation of the United States than Christmas Day 1776. A few thousand ordinary individuals, ragged, largely barefoot, hungry, and as varied in ethnicity, nationality, race, religion, social and financial standing, as any group one could possibly imagine, united and achieved a remarkable victory that turned the tide of the war for the American Revolution. What was the character of these men? What united them despite their diversity and differences? What made them so dissimilar from the British soldiers and their mercenary armies, which had so ruthlessly crushed numerous other colonial uprisings? We will examine the exemplary case of the Marblehead Regiment, the soldier-mariners, who rowed Washington across the Delaware. This knowledge of our true roots is indispensable to returning ourselves and America to our true revolutionary identity. . . If you are in the NYC area and wish to attend in person, use the RSVP button to receive the details about the location. Otherwise, you may join us on Friday by using the YouTube link below. | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/december_22_2023_symposium?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231222_symposium&n=2 "RSVP for in-person") [RSVP for in-person](https://www.sareforsenate.com/december_22_2023_symposium?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231222_symposium&n=2)

There is probably no single day in history more decisive for the creation of the United States than Christmas Day 1776. A few thousand ordinary individuals, ragged, largely barefoot, hungry, and as varied in ethnicity, nationality, race, religion, social and financial standing, as any group one could possibly imagine, united and achieved a remarkable victory that turned the tide of the war for the American Revolution. What was the character of these men? What united them despite their diversity and differences? What made them so dissimilar from the British soldiers and their mercenary armies, which had so ruthlessly crushed numerous other colonial uprisings? We will examine the exemplary case of the Marblehead Regiment, the soldier-mariners, who rowed Washington across the Delaware. This knowledge of our true roots is indispensable to returning ourselves and America to our true revolutionary identity. . . The truth is, Democrats have no room for error when it comes to keeping our Senate majority in 2024. If the GOP wins the open Senate seat in West Virginia, they only need to beat one Democratic incumbent to retake the majority. And Bob Casey in Pennsylvania is one of their targets. In 2020, Joe Biden and Kamala Harris won Pennsylvania by a 1.17% margin. With Bob Casey up for re-election next year against an anti-abortion, self-funding, mega-millionaire hedge fund exec — David McCormick — that means Democrats’ early attention and support in Pennsylvania is critical.
